headline: IOC lifts suspension, paves way for Russians to compete at LA 2028 Olympics
context: No decision yet on whether Russia may display its flag, colours or have its anthem played at ​the Games.

sources.name: Al Jazeera

sources.name: NPR
sources.summary: The International Olympic Committee advised sports bodies to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
sources.title: International Olympic Committee lifts Russia suspension ahead of 2028 LA Games
